description: This PHP source file defines the AdminProgramForm class, which extends AbstractFormProcessor to create and manage an administrative form for program entities within the Goteo platform. The class includes methods for form creation, validation constraints, and saving form data to the model, handling fields like title, description, header image, icon, action, URL, and date.

classes.name: AdminProgramForm
classes.description: Handles creation, validation, and saving of the administrative program form within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for form fields, enforcing that certain fields are not left blank.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Sets up the form fields with types, labels, constraints, and other options for admin program management.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data and persists it to the model, handling header image uploads/removals and other program data.
